name: Check .env.example Sync
description: When bot code uses os.getenv with a new variable, remind to add it to .env.example

then.prompt: A Python file in bot/ was edited. If any new os.getenv() calls were added, check that the corresponding environment variable is documented in bot/.env.example with a comment explaining what it does and where to get the value. Only flag this if a genuinely new env var was introduced.
